title: Hosin F Possible NDE 3663
content: Baghdad, 21 October, 1996. I was cutting a tree in the garden of my house. After a lot of effort, I felt cardiac problems then I was in swoon. I was transferred to the hospital and was admitted the intensive care unit. I stayed seventy-two hours. The doctor told me that I had a heart infarction and the remedy would take six months. After a week while sleeping one night, with my son sleeping close to me, I felt something swooped into my face. I was scared a lot. I tried to open my eyes but I couldn't because it was as if there was a barrier between my eyes and that thing. I tried talk to my son but I couldn't move my tongue or the muscles of my jaw. I lost consciousness so I couldn't hear. I also tried to move my feet but I could not, so I succumbed. I felt that I entered to a black eerie and awesome world looking like a long tunnel. Suddenly I felt a twinge of needle at my left wrist, and then I felt my body was coming back to me and my soul returned to my body. I heard the daylight call to prayer. I thought that maybe I had a bad nightmare. Two weeks after I had the same thing happen, I felt something swooped into my face. I entered to dark black tunnel, and then I reached to a shining colored phosphoric golden world. I looked at myself, I couldn't see my body so I knew that I had left it behind, it was on the bed and my family was crying there. The speed was much more light speed, but it was fun. I tried to turn my head around me but I could not my sight was straight ahead only. I exited that world to a third world, this new world looked like our world at sunrise time, with some clouds, with wafts of breeze, I said to myself here I will not suffer anymore, this is the end of sickness and fatigue. Again, I tried to look around me but I could not. After that, I felt a twinge of needle at my left wrist. Then I felt my body was coming back to me and my soul returned to my body, and again I heard the calling to the daylight. In the next patrol medical check, he checked my heart as a routine, I noticed marks of exclamatory on his face, and he asked me what happened to you? I told him the story, then I looked at the mirror and I saw my left eye pulled down! And it was some of shiners up to my face.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Perceived self as having left the body (could not see body) and saw the body on the bed with family crying.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt something 'swooped into my face'; paralysis (could not open eyes, move jaw/tongue/feet) before losing consciousness.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described speed as 'much more [than] light speed' and 'fun'.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'shining colored phosphoric golden world'; then a third world like 'our world at sunrise time, with some clouds, with wafts of breeze.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return triggered by a 'twinge of needle' at the left wrist, after which 'my body was coming back to me and my soul returned to my body.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Heart infarction (after cardiac problems while cutting a tree; ICU stay 72 hours). Experiences occurred during sleep about a week later and again two weeks later.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated episodes during sleep with paralysis preceding entry into a dark tunnel; later a shining golden realm and then a sunrise-like realm; return associated with a needle-like sensation at left wrist and hearing the call to prayer.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Two episodes: (1) paralysis → dark tunnel → needle sensation at wrist → return; (2) paralysis → dark tunnel → shining golden realm → sunrise-like realm → needle sensation at wrist → return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Two similar episodes with tunnel and return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Episodes occurred during sleep after a heart infarction; inability to turn head/sight fixed straight ahead; return repeatedly triggered by a 'twinge of needle' at the left wrist; afterward noticed left eye 'pulled down' and 'some of shiners up to my face.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I entered to a black eerie and awesome world looking like a long tunnel.” “The speed was much more light speed, but it was fun.” “I couldn't see my body so I knew that I had left it behind, it was on the bed and my family was crying there.” “this new world looked like our world at sunrise time, with some clouds, with wafts of breeze.”
